newsitem.title: USA: First West Virginia to issue 4 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: First West Virginia to issue 4 pct stock div.

text.p: First West Virginia Bancorp Inc said Tuesday it declared its regular quarterly cash dividend of 19 cents per share to be paid to its shareholders for the fourth quarter of 1996.
The dividend will be paid December 16, 1996, to shareholders of record November 29, 1996.
The company also said it declared a four percent stock dividend payable on December 16, 1996, to shareholders of record as of close of business December 2, 1996.

As a result of the stock dividend, the company said, each shareholder is entitled to receive one additional share of common stock for each 25 shares held as of December 2, 1996, the record date. The company said cash is being paid in lieu of fractional shares.
